verdict.rationale: Riskified's Login API explicitly scores account-takeover attempts (allow/notify/challenge) alongside its core checkout fraud decisioning (decide/submit/advise) and automated chargeback handling, showing the same system spans multiple fraud surfaces beyond checkout. However, there is no documentation of fake-account-creation detection or promo/coupon abuse scoring as distinct managed surfaces. Missing for 10: explicit fake-account-creation protection, promo/policy abuse scoring, and independent confirmation these are unified in one decisioning system.
